Data.subject: Research and Development (R&D)
Data.title: Research And Development Expenditure By Institutional Sector And Area Of Research, Annual
Data.datasource: AGENCY FOR SCIENCE, TECHNOLOGY AND RESEARCH
Data.footnote: Data on research and development (R&D) in Singapore are collected through the National Survey of Research, Innovation and Enterprise (RIE), conducted on an annual basis by the Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR).  The institutional sectors in the RIE Survey are broadly split into three sectors, namely (a) 'Private sector' comprises all business enterprises, excluding institutions of higher learning; (b) 'Government sector' comprises all government organisations, including government ministries, statutory boards & public research institutes and excluding institutes of higher learning; and (c) 'Institutes of Higher Learning' comprises institutions of higher learning, including the universities and polytechnics.  For detailed definitions for areas of research, please refer to 'Section 7. Explanatory Notes and Definitions' of the publication 'National Survey of Research, Innovation and Enterprise (RIE)' at https://www.a-star.edu.sg/News/national-survey-of-rie

row.footnote: Figures prior to 2002 exclude 'Computer & Related Sciences', which was published as a standalone category.
With effect from the release of 2022 publication, public research entities have been subsumed under the Government Sector for conceptual alignment with OECD.
